Round 4: Thread B opened payments-svc CACHE_STAMPEDE ongoing (round-04/board.md:3) BUT logs show 429 upstream=fx-rates in payments-svc (round-04/logs/payments-svc.log:1,3,7,25) and checkout-api (round-04/logs/checkout-api.log:9,19,50,53) -> likely UPSTREAM_RATE_LIMIT, not stampede. CHG-133 APPLIED TLS ticket rotation (noise?). Pool exhausted continues auth-svc.log:7,9,19,26 search-api.log:4,11,13,14. Next: advance round 5.
